uploadFile-url.label: Address
uploadFile-url.tip: URL of the upload target, supports variables

uploadFile-callback.label: Callback
uploadFile-callback.tip: callback function after upload completion, @code represents the return value (error is -1), @response represents the response data

uploadFile-rateCallback.label: Progress Callback
uploadFile-rateCallback.tip: upload progress callback function, @event represents the progress event object
